export function buildPrompt(options: {
  sourceLanguage: string; targetLanguage: string; systemPrompt: string
  sourceText: string; examples: { source: string; target: string }[]
}): ChatMessage[] {
  const sys = options.systemPrompt
    .replace(/\{sourceLanguage\}/g, options.sourceLanguage)
    .replace(/\{targetLanguage\}/g, options.targetLanguage)

  let user = ""
  for (const ex of options.examples) user += `Source: ${ex.source}\nTranslation: ${ex.target}\n\n`
  user += `Source: ${options.sourceText}\nTranslation:`

  return [{ role: "system", content: sys }, { role: "user", content: user.trim() }]
summary: buildPrompt constructs the LLM chat messages from sourceLanguage, targetLanguage, systemPrompt, sourceText, and an array of examples. Examples are formatted as "Source: {source}\nTranslation: {target}" pairs in the user message.

Desktop codex-editor webview recording flow. Uses MediaRecorder with webm/opus @ 256kbps, 48kHz mono, no echoCancellation/noiseSuppression. Accumulates chunks in audioChunksRef, on stop calls saveAudioToCell(blob) which base64-encodes and posts saveAudioAttachment message to extension host. Audio ID format: audio-{cellId}-{Date.now()}-{9-char-random}. File naming: audio-{cellId}-{ts}-{rand}.{ext} where ext is webm/wav/mp3/m4a/ogg (webm default).

Desktop extension host handler for saveAudioAttachment message from webview. Validates audioId (alphanumeric+dash), whitelists extensions (webm/wav/mp3/m4a/ogg), enforces 50MB max. Atomic dual-write: .project/attachments/files/{segment}/{audioId}.{ext} AND .project/attachments/pointers/{segment}/{audioId}.{ext} (temp file → rename). Then calls document.updateCellAttachment to write CodexCellAttachment{url,type:'audio',createdAt,updatedAt,isDeleted:false,createdBy:username} into cell.metadata.attachments[audioId] and sets cell.metadata.selectedAudioId. Auto-selects new recording. Responds with audioAttachmentSaved{cellId,audioId,requestId,success,savedToCodexFile}. Audio recordings are written as direct binary, NOT LFS-pointerified (LFS infra exists only for imported audio).

Web app cell attachment shape matches desktop: CodexCellAttachment{url,type,createdAt?,updatedAt?,isDeleted?,isMissing?}. Cell metadata carries attachments?: Record<string, CodexCellAttachment> + selectedAudioId?: string. Memoized regex cache for rule-engine. Compiles each (flags, pattern) once and reuses the RegExp across cells and calls. Failed compiles cached as null so invalid patterns don't retry. Safe for cached reuse because only `i` flag patterns use `.test()` and `gi` patterns use `.match()` (which resets lastIndex). Unbounded growth risk is bounded by number of unique rule patterns (low). Added 2026-04-24 to fix per-keystroke lag where `new RegExp` was called per cell per rule.

Persistent DualIndex cached at module scope, keyed by per-cell content signature `${fileId}|${original}|${translated}`. Replaces full `buildFromProject` rebuild per call with incremental `addPair`/`removePair` diff. Works correctly across project switches (all prev IDs get removed, all new IDs get added — same cost as rebuild, no special handling). Module-level state is safe: in prod each Worker instance has its own module; in tests `resetHealthSyncCache()` is exported but not currently called (tests pass without it because signature diff handles test-to-test cell set changes correctly).

useCompositeHealth: 200ms debounce on health recompute. Each keystroke triggers buildCells() which creates ~1000 new HealthSyncCell objects. Eventually queued to worker. But still creates garbage per keystroke.

summary: @huggingface/transformers and kokoro-js are pre-included in optimizeDeps so Vite bundles them at server start instead of triggering a mid-flight re-optimize on first AI button click. Without these entries, the first transcription or TTS dynamic import causes Vite to re-optimize, which forces a full page reload and kills the in-progress model download (the white-screen issue from Tauri/dev). Production builds aren't affected.

prefetchAiModels: background download orchestrator. Sends "warmup" messages to whisper-worker and kokoro-worker (each calls its pipeline init, which fetches model weights into the browser Cache API and reports progress). Status is exposed via useModelStatus(modelId) which returns idle/downloading/ready/error. Hydrated from localStorage `codex.modelReady.{whisper|kokoro}` on app start. Driven from the onboarding checklist's "Enable AI voice & transcription" step (AiModelsStep); progress is also rendered in the floating AiModelDownloadChip mounted at the App root. Independent from the per-feature consent dialog — the onboarding step pre-grants consent and pre-warms models so feature buttons are instant.

Singleton "currently active audio" coordinator. ActiveAudioController is a small delegating shape — { isPlaying: () => bool, play, pause } — registered by useCellAudio's first play() call. Global Space shortcut (App > GlobalAudioShortcuts > useGlobalAudioShortcuts) calls togglePlayActive() to pause/resume the most-recently-played cell. isInEditableContext gates Space behavior so typing in TipTap still inserts a space. setActiveAudio dedups by reference so same-controller re-registration doesn't notify subscribers.
